summary: Hypothermic hunter triggered SOS via Garmin inReach near Buck Basin after a blizzard dumped 3+ feet; three-person SAR team skied 7 miles in overnight and Army National Guard Blackhawk flew everyone out
location: Buck Basin, Horse Ranch Park area
responding_agency: Crested Butte Mountain Rescue + Army National Guard Blackhawk
notes: approx; subject: Justin Finch, 32, of Utah — mule-deer hunter; blizzard buried his tent under ~3 ft of snow, inReach SOS ~3 p.m. Oct 28 from an avalanche path after a failed hike-out in wet clothes; 3-person CBSAR team skied 7 mi in overnight, reached him ~4:30 a.m., Blackhawk evac ~1:30 p.m. Oct 29; his two llamas (pack animals) rescued the next day; he recounted it on the Epic Outdoors podcast. NOTE: the CSAR WMRT hunter-rescue story (Beaver Creek/Little Mill Creek leg injury, 13-member uphaul, MC McKenzie McConnell) is a DIFFERENT incident — still pending, no date.
